content.short: Rango is a cross-chain DEX and bridge aggregator routing swaps across many networks.
content.description: Rango aggregates both DEXes and bridges, searching across them for a route between two assets on different chains and handling the multi-step execution. Monad's documentation lists it among the chain's aggregators. Aggregating bridges as well as exchanges is a harder problem than either alone, since a route's cost depends on liquidity and finality on both sides at the time of execution.
content.meta: Rango is a cross-chain DEX and bridge aggregator routing swaps across many networks including Monad.
